liveSchemaBaselineNote: Measured against LIVE schema discovered this run (problems, problem_assets, writing_drafts, writing_submissions, study_events, plus feedback/recommendation/library tables). No assumed columns used.

seedProvenance.shape: ARRAY length 62, each item homogeneous keys
seedProvenance.stableId: item.id (uuid) — used as deterministic seed provenance; NEVER array index

rows.screenRequirement: 53번 문제 본문(prompt) 표시 — '다음을 참고하여 200~300자로 글을 쓰시오' 등 과제 지시문
rows.docSource: description.md L37 '53번 지문, 그래프, 조건, 참고 자료를 좌측에 배치함'; functional-spec.md L41 problems(prompt) read
rows.rationale: description.md confirms the screen renders the question prompt; problems.prompt is a typed text column read by question_no=53. sample prompt_text maps directly by meaning.

rows.screenRequirement: 문제 식별 — question_no=53 으로 53번 장문 문제를 구분
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md L36 '확정 계약: question_no = 53으로 구분한다'; functional-spec.md L41 problems(id, question_no)
rows.rationale: Stable filter need: route loads the 53 problem by question_no. LIVE schema CHECK question_no IN (51,52,53,54) confirms typed column. Seed JSON has no own question_no key; provenance question_no is fixed at 53 by folder/route, not from JSON.

rows.screenRequirement: 그래프/표/자료 표시 — 도표(chart_a 막대, chart_b 도넛), 단위, 축/연도, 시리즈 값, 참고 자료/조건
rows.docSource: description.md L37 '그래프, 조건, 참고 자료'; screen-data-summary.md L36 '확정 계약: problems.materials와 problem_assets가 도표와 참고 자료를 담는다'
rows.jsonCandidateKey: chart_a, chart_b, context_notes, relation, scenario_logic, chart_roles, approved_graph_logic
rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL: screen-data-summary.md 확정 계약 column ACCEPTS problems.materials jsonb for the chart/material structure (and the '스키마 보강 필요' row L38 is explicitly about typed validation of 축/범례/수치/비교 only, with 메모 '현재는 materials JSON과 asset 파일로 표현한다'). description.md states the screen RENDERS the chart but states NO concrete stable-query/validation need on the inner numeric structure, so the jsonb blob serves. Chart objects map into materials by meaning.

rows.screenRequirement: 53번 도표 세부 구조의 typed 검증 — 축, 범례, 수치, 비교 포인트를 컬럼으로 쿼리/검증
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md L38 '스키마 보강 필요: 축, 범례, 수치, 비교 포인트를 typed 컬럼으로 검증하는 구조는 없다' (메모: 현재는 materials JSON으로 표현)
rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL + STABLE-QUERY: although LABELED '스키마 보강 필요', the 확정 계약/메모 accept current materials jsonb storage and description.md provides NO concrete query/validation/render-by-column requirement (the editor only displays the chart). Per the rule this stays jsonb-covered, stableQueryNeed=false; do not invent typed chart columns. The augmentation desire is a documented future-stabilization wish, not a confirmed screen gap.

rows.screenRequirement: 문제 자료 이미지/오디오 자산 연결 — 도표 이미지가 파일인 경우 표시, 이미지 실패 시 대체
rows.docSource: functional-spec.md L42 problem_assets(problem_id, storage_path, asset_type) read; description.md L41 '자료 누락/이미지 실패 시 대체 텍스트와 재시도 표시'
rows.rationale: Screen needs to resolve asset files for a problem; problem_assets has typed storage_path + asset_type(image/audio) + FK problem_id. Seed JSON carries no file asset (charts are inline structured data), so no JSON key maps — assets are operationally seeded/uploaded separately.

rows.screenRequirement: 구성 안내 / 평가 기준 카드 / 채점 기준(rubric) — 조건 충족, 평가 기준 표시
rows.docSource: description.md L61 '조건 충족 여부, 평가 기준, 자료 반영 상태를 보조 지표로 제공'; functional-spec.md L41 problems(rubric)
rows.rationale: The 평가 기준 카드 is a supporting indicator (보조 지표). problems.rubric is a jsonb column in LIVE schema; rubric object {content,structure,language} maps by meaning. No stable per-criterion column query need is stated in description.md — jsonb serves.

rows.screenRequirement: 모범답안/정답 키 — 채점·기준 계산 보조 데이터 (자료 반영 상태 계산 근거)
rows.docSource: functional-spec.md L41 problems(answer_key) read; description.md L65 '기준 계산 실패 시 수동 체크 안내로 대체'
rows.rationale: functional-spec lists answer_key in the read set; LIVE schema problems.answer_key is jsonb. model_answer + narrative slots map by meaning as the answer reference. description.md does not require a typed column query, so jsonb-covered.

rows.screenRequirement: 장문 답안 본문 입력 (원고지 에디터) — 작성 중 본문 텍스트
rows.docSource: description.md L49 '장문 답안을 원고지 형식으로 작성하는 핵심 입력 영역'; screen-data-summary.md L27 answer_text
rows.rationale: Core input; writing_drafts.answer_text is typed text column. User-entered, no seed JSON source. model_answer is the PROBLEM reference (problems.answer_key), not the user draft — do not conflate.

rows.screenRequirement: 문단/구조 정보 (answer_json) — 문단 수 표시, 구조화 답안
rows.docSource: description.md L51 '문단 수 표시'; screen-data-summary.md L27 answer_json
rows.rationale: answer_json holds paragraph/structure breakdown; LIVE writing_drafts.answer_json jsonb. Paragraph count is a derived display, no stable column query need. User-generated.

rows.screenRequirement: 글자 수 / 목표 글자 수 / 현재 작성량 — 200~300자 권장, 최소 120자 검증
rows.docSource: description.md L51 '200-300자 권장, 최소 120자', L73 '목표 글자 수, 현재 작성량'; screen-data-summary.md L27 char_count
rows.rationale: char_count is a typed integer column on writing_drafts (and writing_submissions). The 200~300/120 thresholds are client validation constants (검수 필요: 'autosave 주기/글자수 제한을 문서 계약으로 고정' L69) — not new columns. User-derived.

rows.screenRequirement: 자동저장 상태 + 마지막 저장 시각 — 자동저장/저장 실패 경고
rows.docSource: description.md L73 '자동저장', L77 '자동저장 실패 시 경고 색상과 재시도 액션'; functional-spec.md L43 writing_drafts(autosave_status, last_saved_at)
rows.rationale: autosave_status typed text with CHECK ('clean','dirty','syncing','failed','superseded') and last_saved_at timestamptz fully cover the autosave UI states incl. 저장 실패. Runtime-generated.

rows.screenRequirement: 활성 draft 단일성 — 사용자×문제당 활성 임시저장 1개
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md L45 '활성 draft는 사용자와 문제 기준 1개만 허용된다'
rows.rationale: LIVE partial unique constraint exactly encodes the single-active-draft contract; satisfied by current schema.

rows.screenRequirement: 최종 제출 + 제출 상태(피드백 상태) — 제출 확인(D-M1), 중복 제출 방지
rows.docSource: functional-spec.md L44 writing_submissions(problem_id, answer_text, answer_json, char_count, feedback_status); description.md L100 '제출은 D-M1 제출 확인 모달'; functional-spec L31 '중복 제출'
rows.rationale: writing_submissions has typed columns + feedback_status CHECK ('pending','analyzing','complete','failed') + immutable RLS (no update/delete) which backs the 중복 제출 immutability. User-generated.

rows.screenRequirement: 제출 처리 트랜잭션 — 제출 시 submission + feedback 초기 row 생성
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md L47 'rpc:public.submit_writing_with_feedback ... 제출, 피드백, 영역 점수, 문장 피드백을 한 트랜잭션으로 만든다'; L37 '확정 계약: submit_writing_with_feedback이 제출/피드백 생성을 묶는다'
rows.liveDbObject: rpc public.submit_writing_with_feedback (writes writing_submissions + writing_feedback + feedback_dimension_scores + sentence_feedback)
rows.rationale: Doc 확정 계약 names the RPC; the LIVE schema includes all target tables (writing_submissions, writing_feedback, feedback_dimension_scores, sentence_feedback). RPC body not in the discovered baseline list (which is table-only) → strong-inference, not directly read this run, but every write target table is present and satisfied.

rows.docSource: functional-spec.md L45 study_events(event_type, problem_id, submission_id, payload) write; description.md L19/87 '작성, 저장/제출'
rows.rationale: study_events has typed columns + frozen event_type catalog (practice_started, draft_autosaved, submission_submitted, ...) covering start/submit events; payload jsonb for extras. Telemetry write, no JSON seed, no stable per-event-field query need on this screen.

rows.screenRequirement: 이탈/자동저장 경고 모달 게이팅 (D-M3) — 저장 실패 시 강제 이탈 확인
rows.docSource: description.md L29 '저장 실패 상태에서는 이탈 확인 모달을 강제 표시'; L100 'D-M3 자동저장 경고'
rows.rationale: Leave-guard is client gating driven by the autosave_status='failed' value already in the typed column; no new persisted field needed.

rows.screenRequirement: 사이드 내비 / 앱 기본 이동 구조 유지
rows.docSource: description.md L25 '53번 장문 작성 중에도 앱 기본 이동 구조를 유지함'
rows.rationale: Pure layout/navigation chrome, not a data requirement. No DB object needed — intentionally (missing) with satisfied (no data dependency).

jsonMapping.meaning: Stable per-item uuid; used as deterministic seed id for the 53 problem (NOT array index). Source file + this id preserved as provenance.
Full task instruction shown to learner ('다음을 참고하여 200~300자로 글을 쓰시오...'). Maps by meaning + name.
Human-readable problem title/topic for the 53 item; title is NOT NULL so derived from topic_seed_title.

jsonMapping.jsonKey: chart_a, chart_b, context_notes, relation, scenario_logic, chart_roles, approved_graph_logic, meta
jsonMapping.meaning: All chart/graph structure, units, series values, cross-chart bridge and context labels — stored as the materials blob (jsonb-covered, no typed chart columns).
Scoring rubric {content, structure, language} for the writing item.
Reference model answer + narrative slots used as answer key / grading reference. Maps by MEANING (answer reference) not by key name.
Seed meta.domain is a topic domain ('경제'); the schema domain is the TOPIK skill domain and must be clamped to 'writing' for question 53 (deterministic derive, not from JSON value).
Difficulty 1-5; seed value (e.g. 4) maps; clamp to CHECK 1..5.
Review gate; review_passed=true derives review_status='approved'. Deterministic derive, not a direct column copy.
Provenance-fixed constants for the D-03 / question 53 seed (53 is TOPIK II writing). Not read from JSON.

frozenIslandNote: No admin codes (H-01/X-08/X-10/X-15) and no frozen objects (organizations, org_members, assignments, assignment_submissions, admin_*/get_admin_*) touched. All rows resolve to user-facing problems/writing/study_events tables.
idempotencyNote: Any seed would be an ADDITIVE upsert on problems.id derived from sample-53.json item.id (deterministic), with domain clamped to 'writing', question_no=53, difficulty clamped 1..5 — unchanged source re-run is a byte-identical no-op. No drop/reset/truncate. NOTE: no migration is being applied here — this is the conformance matrix only (READ-ONLY run).
overallVerdict: All confirmed screen data requirements are SATISFIED or JSONB-COVERED by the LIVE schema. The single documented '스키마 보강 필요' item (typed chart sub-structure) stays jsonb-covered per CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL since the 확정 계약/메모 accept materials jsonb and description.md states no concrete typed-column query/validation need. No schema-gap, no unresolved escalation.
